summary: Completed a read-only architecture review of PortalSifast for dbsimrs→primary inventory mirroring. The app uses dual MySQL connections (default primary + dbsimrs via DB_*_2 env vars). Inventaris is currently implemented as direct read/write Eloquent on dbsimrs tables with no primary-DB mirror, no scheduled sync, and no inventaris audit log. Existing sync precedents include: manual user sync (SyncUsersFromSimrs), payroll CSV upsert with audit/rollback (EmployeeSalaryImportService), WebOfficial polyclinic extension keyed by kd_poli, and cache-only mirrors (Instagram/RSS/doctor schedules). Cross-DB links use string keys (tickets.asset_no_inventaris, users.simrs_nik) without FK constraints. Key risks for a read-only mirror: dual-write conflict, portal-local photos stored in dbsimrs rows, deletion/orphan handling, stale cache, and ticket references to removed SIMRS assets.
current_status: Inventaris module is live against dbsimrs with full CRUD, photo proxy, and ticket linkage; primary DB has 73 migrations but zero inventaris tables. Queues use database driver with minimal jobs (payslip email, panic FCM). Scheduled tasks cover tickets/panic/notifications and optional Instagram/RSS only—not SIMRS user or inventaris sync. A read-only mirror would be a new pattern; closest templates are payroll upsert + polyclinic extension + cache sync.
